goal: Add deterministic in-process end-to-end failure-injection coverage for the shared proxy control plane: proxy-auth 407 and transport failure drive health/circuit failure, half-open recovery succeeds with hysteresis, generation rotation invalidates an old AccountRuntime, and a fresh runtime generation is admitted.
context: This is a test-harness batch, not a production behavior redesign. Compose existing network.HealthReportingTransport/TransportObserver semantics, proxycontrol state-machine functions, and AccountRuntime.CheckMutationGeneration using fakes. Keep the new scenario entirely in internal/app; do NOT modify provider driver test files. Provider parity is verified by running the existing DigitalOcean/Vultr/VultrConsole suites after the shared scenario. Do not call real provider APIs, require network access, add schema, sleep, or duplicate production state-machine logic.
commit_message: test(proxy): prove control-plane failure recovery e2e
